contract.provides: The available P1 return replaces its per-part ceramic carriers/retracting beds with ordinary components on removable seven-part leaves, passive paired contacts, a passive cap and shared observed service tooling. It derives a conditional installed-loop resistance certificate and an explicit shunt blind spot. The reported continuous conditional campaign takes47.36h and about668USD/instrument versus520USD ordinary, missing full targets; target-tool swept geometry, persistent-jam recovery and contact qualification remain open. ROOT adds a passive thermal maximum principle and introduced shared-head/retention models without supplying a real joint or complete service. Earlier constructions retain their separate parameters and scopes. 56-component,136-terminal-join,43-net optical head with32 qualifying submillimetre passives, proposed23.4x23.4x23.2mm envelope, paid external instrument and three useful geometric arrangements. Shared tooling must capture the leaf, independently own seven component loads before cap removal, positively own/open one target, test it isolated, restore receiver stock and qualify assembled function after every tool withdraws. Conditional electrical bounds require the stated installed error and unintended-path topology.

source_excerpts.text:
A. Governing sources and exact observation limits

Morris--Isaacson--Grapes--Dubey, 2011:
https://www.mdpi.com/2072-666X/2/1/69
Actual metadata and main Sections1--4/lines169--277 were read, including fabrication, magnetic/capillary geometry and yield definition. Fabricated roughly280um silicon parts combined magnets with solder-wettable features. The reported8.01% is174 correct binding events out of2172 available sites on362 analysed parts; it is not8% fully functioning devices. Unexpected etch depth altered magnetic geometry and enabled wrong attachment. Intended electrical paths are not a demonstrated heterogeneous electronic system. No figures were visually inspected, cited originals or linked fabrication sources followed. This independent construction is distinct from the held2004 sequential shape-and-solder paper and the held2023 controlled-viscosity MicroLED identity.

Itera exact https://www.itera.co/ and supported Tech link https://www.itera.co/tech :
Both whole returned main pages read. The company claims configurable liquid-metal substrates, real-component tests, internal-node probing and under60s reconfiguration. These are maker claims, not an independently measured throughput, delivered-service quote, component-placement time, three-dimensional assembly, electrical rating, yield or renewal-life certificate. No waitlist/contact/sign-up or images followed. Merely proposing programmable wiring does not establish a new operation against this predecessor.

Hamilton--Sottos--White, online2011/issue2012:
https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3306641/
Actual main Methods/Results/Conclusion108--252 and metadata were read from the first returned page. Sparse vascular channels and external pumping delivered reactive fluids into a prepared epoxy fracture; dynamic pumping improved mixing. Testing included load-frame support, manual excess-fluid removal,48h cure at30C and, in the stronger repeated case, lateral clamping. Accumulated healed film impeded flow and reduced later recovery in unclamped samples. These are measured fracture-recovery operations, not an autonomous soft actuator or unlimited regeneration. Source equations rendered as images were not reconstructed; figures, cited originals and supporting files were not followed.

Beckett etal2025, DOI10.1021/acsmaterialslett.4c01358:
https://rcastoragev2.blob.core.windows.net/dbf8078788dbaf821657036f6
